BrochureContent.Content:
Named Barnhill Brae, 38 Killyconnigan, Monaghan is a delightful 4 bedroom detached bungalow set on a c.0.47ac site within a quiet cul-de-sac overlooking the beautiful surroundings of Rossmore Forest Park, in one of Monaghan's most sought-after residential locations.

Extending to c.140m2 this property benefits from having four generously proportioned bedrooms, the property has been thoughtfully designed to provide comfortable and versatile accommodation. The master bedroom benefits from a private shower ensuite, while the remaining bedrooms are well suited for family living or guest accommodation.

At the heart of the home is a fully fitted kitchen with adjoining living area, complete with integrated appliances, complemented by two spacious reception rooms and an additional sun lounge that enjoys views over the beautifully landscaped gardens. These flexible living spaces are ideal for both everyday family life and entertaining.

The property further benefits from dual central heating (oil-fired and solid fuel back boiler), double-glazed windows throughout, and excellent energy efficiency.

Outside, the home occupies an elevated, substantial corner plot with mature landscaped gardens to the front and a fully enclosed, private rear patio and garden, creating a peaceful outdoor retreat with exceptional privacy.

Combining generous accommodation, a prime setting adjacent to Rossmore Forest Park, and excellent outdoor space, this outstanding bungalow presents an ideal opportunity for families or those seeking spacious single-storey living.

Early viewing is highly recommended and is strictly by appointment only.
